pages.title: Field Emitter
pages.text: A compact emitter of neutronium plate, Cherenkov quartz and a quantum dot that projects a field shaped by the dot's quantum state. Change the state, change the field. It sits warm and quiet, faintly buzzing.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Multiblocks kept needing local fields of different shapes. A quantum dot can hold a programmed state, and Cherenkov quartz can turn that state into a field. I have also found ready-made emitters in anomaly vaults.

Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Anomaly Vault chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Horizon Simulation.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Chronal Field Projector, Dark Energy Siphon, Dark Matter Halo Collector, Dimensional Lift Projector, Dimensional Stabiliser, Graviton Field Emitter, Graviton Field Projector, Hawking Radiation Collector and more.
